decision: Project only additional bounded public card fields using exact snake/uppercase/camel aliases. Preserve exact ID fields and existing per-platform session boundary. Choose strict colon duration strings, prioritizing official preferred vod_duration and retaining normal search duration; the official preferred Number type is seconds, while ambiguous numeric strings and unrelated raw duration numbers remain hidden. Decode common/numeric entities once into plain text in native discovery without HTML execution. Thumbnail still passes the existing strict HTTPS/CDN allowlist. Preserve selection, downloads, card geometry, saved session and all CHZZK/YouTube code.
